rows.description: Weather message delivered to Telegram by 7:30 AM with current conditions, today's forecast, and recommendations
Voice summary plays through VoiceServer with Kaya's voice, under 30 seconds
Clothing recommendation is contextually appropriate for San Diego weather patterns
Activity recommendation reflects actual conditions (rain awareness, UV, temperature)
3-day forecast included in Telegram message with notable changes highlighted
Severe weather alerts surface when NWS has active warnings for San Diego
Enhanced WeatherBlock works within DailyBriefing without breaking existing block system
Standalone mode works via `bun WeatherMessenger.ts` with `--dry-run` for testing
Configuration is fully controllable via BriefingConfig.yaml
Graceful degradation: message still delivers even if recommendations or alerts fail
